owns: Git and CI after Architect GO

functions: inspect_staged_pdf_capture(*, prepared: Path | str, operation_id: object, upstream_root: Path | str, vault_root: Path | str) -> dict[str, object]

path_rules: Only these exact production/test paths may be edited or created by Builder. The fixture suffix /** means files strictly below that one directory only.
Do not edit frozen contract, schemas, architecture evidence, status documents, task index, AGENTS.md or successor-carried records.
Do not stage, commit, push, alter PR state, access a real Vault, or use network/models.
If any frozen contract or schema is internally inconsistent, stop and report the exact blocker; do not repair architecture bytes.

requirements: Extract one public pure encode_transaction_inspect_bundle with the frozen exact built-in shape, bounded grammar, portable collision, map-correlation and disjointness checks.
Preserve accepted compact bytes for every existing staging/upstream vector.
The encoder does no I/O and does not enforce 8 MiB. Existing staging retains digest-mismatch-before-limit order; staged capture records the computed digest then applies the limit.
The adapter private compatibility wrapper delegates and maps the impossible post-proposal failure to its existing caller-selected mismatch code.
For paper-source only, publish prepared/<approval-ref input sha>.blob then prepared/staged-pdf-capture-request.v1.json in one retained checkout/work/batch/prepared session.
Embed the parsed nine-field desensitized approval-ref and exact canonical plan/PDF descriptors; never store approval-ref path/raw bytes or claim approval authority.
Validate canonical plan bytes, approval binding, pipeline/limits/network digests, PDF magic/parse/encryption/pages/bytes before publication.
Use one retained lineage with plan sibling checks around each install and success; two independent stage_bytes calls are forbidden.
Idempotent reuse, missing-blob repair, conflicts, replacements and safe blob orphan behavior must match the contract.
Code-evidence prepare bytes and behavior remain unchanged.
Implement staged-route complete no-follow vault_root/.raw/captured session with maximum 1024 entries.
Select 0 or 1 portable <payload sha>.* sibling; preserve real suffix/mode for reuse. Multiple/malformed/symlink/directory/special/hash/drift cases fail closed.
Retain and reproduce complete name/type/identity inventory around branch, staging, child, error and success boundaries.
Observed drift overrides downstream results with sanitized CAPTURE_SNAPSHOT_INVALID or accepted limit error.
Object-only request/authority validators return deep independent copies and central validate_document dispatches title-scoped semantic checks.
Pure argument/root checks precede filesystem; prepared normalizes to the one fixed request path and derives the batch.
Read canonical request/plan/blob through one retained lineage, bind approval ref, validate PDF and recheck named identities/bytes at every frozen boundary.
Reuse preserves requested_operation_id but creates no facade, encoder call, staging, child, network attempt or write; downstream fields are null.

Create builds exactly one capture facade for .raw/captured/<sha>.pdf, stages exact maps in the retained batch session, invokes accepted pinned read-only inspect and cross-binds the complete authority.
Staging success followed by child failure leaves deterministic staging reusable and never mutates Vault.
Return no absolute paths, bytes, inode/device, environment, credentials, child raw output or timestamp.
Add only capture inspect with four required flags; argparse abbreviation remains disabled.
No batch/digest/plan/blob/work/bundle/target/suffix/apply/cleanup/network/overwrite option is admitted.
Emit the existing closed single JSON envelope and stable errors; zero egress and no admin/apply path.
Cover request and authority semantics, deep-copy isolation and unknown/crossed child rejection.
Cover local-blob/arXiv binding, canonical bytes, prepare idempotence/repair/conflicts, blob-first/request-last and every named-lineage replacement boundary.
Cover PDF magic/parsing/encryption and inclusive byte/page limits.
Cover exact CLI tree/path/root isolation, complete Vault create/reuse/multiple/mismatch/symlink/special/races and retained batch replacement.
Prove reuse has zero process/network/write attempts.
Exercise create through a real pinned public transaction inspector with disposable roots; prove staging reuse after downstream failure.
Lock shared encoder bytes/error order and all accepted staging/adapter vectors.
Assert sanitized errors and no stdout/stderr leakage.

failure_order: canonical plan semantics and descriptor correlation
reuse final postchecks OR create proposal/encoder

builder_complete: Run the complete suite on the available locked Python 3.13 environment.
If the existing Python 3.12 environment is available, run it too; Architect will independently replay both lines.
architect_final: exact-path manifest and cached diff audit

builder_candidate_requirements: Record exact changed path set and per-file SHA256/size.
Record focused and complete commands, interpreter versions, counts and JUnit/log hashes when available.
Record frozen contract/schema/architecture acceptance hashes and verify they are unchanged.
Record catalog count 67, git diff --check, no protected path edits, no real Vault/network/process beyond disposable pinned fixture behavior.
State known limitations and any test not run; never relabel a failure as environment-only without evidence.
Return control to Architect without staging, committing, pushing or editing status files.
absolute_exclusions: accepted architecture evidence except Builder candidate

handoff.on_success: Builder writes only builder-candidate.json and reports exact paths/tests/hashes. Architect reviews; Repo Steward then performs independent candidate review.
handoff.on_blocker: Stop before architectural invention and report the smallest reproducible contract ambiguity or missing allowed path.
handoff.git_owner: Repo Steward only after Architect exact-delivery GO.
